label: Bible Study
prompt: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very _____. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verse: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
note: Day six ends with the Creator's review: not just good this time, but very good.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the _____.
verse: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
note: Weeping gets the night shift; joy clocks in at dawn. The psalmist knows which one has the longer contract.

label: Sunday School
prompt: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, _____ be thy name.
verse: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
note: 'Hallowed' means treated as holy — the Lord's Prayer honors God's name before making a single request.

label: Deep Water
prompt: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am _____.
verse: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
note: The ex-persecutor writes it in the present tense — 'I am,' not 'I was' — chief of sinners.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Preach the word; be _____ in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verse: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
note: 'Be instant in season, out of season' — 'instant' meaning urgent and ready. An ordination-service favorite.
